faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Have questions about account setup, document verification, or payments? Find quick answers below.

items.question: How do I create an account?
items.answer: Visit e-renty.com, click Sign In, then choose to register. Enter your name, email and a password of at least 8 characters. We'll send a 6-digit verification code to your inbox — enter it to activate your account.

items.question: What documents do I need to rent?
items.answer: All customers must pass identity verification before renting. You need to upload an ID card or residence permit, a selfie, a proof-of-address card, and a business registration certificate. Each document is reviewed individually and you'll be notified once approved.

items.question: What payment methods are accepted?
items.answer: We accept Visa/Mastercard, Google Pay, Apple Pay, and bank transfer. Card and wallet payments are processed securely through Stripe — your card details are never stored on our servers.

items.question: Can I pay monthly instead of upfront?
items.answer: Yes. At checkout you choose Monthly (only the first month is charged now, future months appear in your Payments tab with due dates) or Upfront (pay the full period at a discounted rate shown live in the checkout summary).

items.question: What is the minimum rental period?
items.answer: The platform minimum is typically 3 months, though this can vary. The checkout flow clearly shows the minimum — period buttons below it are greyed out and not selectable.

faqs.q: How much does a business fleet cost?
faqs.a: Employee-mobility bikes start from around 25 000 Ft per rider per month, with volume pricing as your fleet grows. Courier support plans start lower. You always get one fixed monthly quote — no hidden fees.

faqs.q: Do we buy or rent the bikes?
faqs.a: You rent. There's no down payment and no residual-value risk. The full monthly fee is expensable, and you can scale the fleet up or down as your needs change.

faqs.q: What are the tax benefits exactly?
faqs.a: VAT is reclaimable on qualifying use, the monthly fee is fully deductible with no social contribution, and e-bikes up to 300 W given to employees are exempt from personal income tax. We're glad to brief your accountant on the details.

faqs.q: What happens when a bike breaks down?
faqs.a: Report it online and our nationwide service network responds within 24 hours. Priority plans include a replacement bike so your operation keeps moving.

faqs.q: Can you brand the bikes for us?
faqs.a: Yes. We wrap and brand fleets in your identity and can add marketing messaging to the frames — turning every ride into advertising.
Typically one to three years for corporate fleets, with flexible short-term options for seasonal and event needs.
We're based in Budapest and Kecskemét with a nationwide service-partner network, so we can support fleets anywhere in Hungary.

businessPage.ctaDesc: Tell us about your team and routes, and we'll come back with the right bikes, a fixed monthly quote, and wheels at your door within a week.
businessPage.ctaNote: Talk to a human — no bots, no obligation.

faqPage.metaDesc: Find answers about E-Renty rentals, Courier+ subscriptions, identity verification, payments, and fleet management.
faqPage.heroDesc: Find answers for your situation. Switch between customer, courier, or business tabs below.

items.q: How do I create an account?
items.a: Visit e-renty.com, click Sign In, then choose to register. Enter your name, email address, and a password of at least 8 characters. We'll send a 6-digit verification code to your inbox — enter it to activate your account. Codes expire after 15 minutes and can be resent after a 60-second cooldown.

items.q: What documents do I need to rent?
items.a:
All customers must pass identity verification (KYC) before renting. You need to upload:
1. ID card (front) or residence permit
2. ID card (back)
3. Selfie — a clear photo of your face
4. Address card (proof of address)
5. Business registration certificate

Each document is reviewed by our team individually. You'll receive a notification once approved or rejected with a reason.

items.q: How long does verification take?
items.a: Typically within one business day. You can monitor the status of each document in your Dashboard → Documents tab. Once all slots show 'Approved', your account is verified and you can place your first rental.

items.q: What is the security deposit?
items.a: A one-time refundable security deposit of 20,000 Ft is charged alongside your very first rental payment. It is never charged again on any subsequent rental. The deposit is returned when your account is closed in good standing.

items.q: Can I rent more than one bike at a time?
items.a: Yes. During checkout you can set the quantity for your rental. Each unit gets its own vehicle assigned from our inventory automatically.

items.q: What payment methods are accepted?
items.a: We accept Visa/Mastercard cards, Google Pay, Apple Pay, and bank transfer. Card and wallet payments are processed securely through Stripe — your card details are never stored on our servers.

items.q: Can I pay monthly instead of all upfront?
items.a:
Yes. At checkout you choose:
• Monthly — only the first month is charged now. Future months appear in your Dashboard → Payments tab.
• Upfront — pay the full period at once at a discounted rate shown live in the checkout summary.

items.q: Are there discounts for longer commitments?
items.a: Yes. Upfront payment discounts are applied automatically based on the number of months you commit to. The exact percentage is shown in the checkout summary before you pay.

items.q: Can I use a coupon code?
items.a: Yes. There is a coupon code field in the checkout flow. Enter your code and the discount is validated instantly and reflected in the price summary.

items.q: How are invoices issued?
items.a: A VAT invoice is generated automatically after every confirmed payment. You can download it from your Dashboard → Documents tab.

items.q: What is the minimum rental period?
items.a: The platform minimum is typically 3 months, but this can change. The checkout flow clearly shows the minimum — period buttons below it are greyed out and not selectable.

items.q: How does vehicle assignment work?
items.a: When you complete checkout, the system automatically assigns an idle vehicle of your chosen model from the nearest available location. You'll see the vehicle number, battery number, and lock number in your Dashboard.

items.q: Can I renew my rental before it expires?
items.a: Yes. On any expiring rental (within 7 days of the end date) you'll see a Renew button. Open it to choose additional months, pick a payment schedule, optionally apply a coupon, and pay.

items.q: What happens if my bike needs repair?
items.a: Contact us through the platform or by phone. Our team arranges collection and assigns the bike to a certified repair partner. A replacement vehicle is arranged where possible.

items.q: How do I return the bike at the end?
items.a: Returns are handled by E-Renty staff at one of our depots. Contact us before the end date to arrange handover. Once the bike is received and inspected, your rental is closed.

items.q: How do I change my email address?
items.a: Go to Dashboard → Settings → Email section. Enter your new address and save. A confirmation is automatically sent to your old address.

items.q: How do I request a copy of my data (GDPR)?
items.a: Go to Dashboard → Settings and use the 'Request Data Export' button. Your full data export will be prepared within 30 days.

items.q: How do I delete my account?
items.a: Go to Dashboard → Settings → Delete Account section. Enter your password to confirm. Active rentals must be returned before deletion can be completed.

items.q: I own my own e-bike — what does Courier+ cover?
items.a: Courier+ is a service subscription for e-bike owners. You keep riding your own bike — we cover scheduled and unscheduled maintenance, GPS device + live tracking, theft insurance with 24/7 monitoring, and roadside assistance. No rental involved.

items.q: Who is Courier+ designed for?
items.a: Courier+ is built for anyone who relies on their own e-bike daily — Wolt and Foodora delivery couriers, independent riders, and commuters who want professional-grade coverage without unexpected repair bills. No minimum mileage or fleet size requirement.

items.q: Is there a deposit or upfront hardware fee?
items.a: No deposit and no upfront hardware cost. The GPS device is included in your plan at no extra charge. You pay only the subscription fee. You can cancel at any time.

items.q: How do I register my bike?
items.a: During checkout enter your bike's VIN (frame number) and an optional description. Once payment is confirmed your bike is registered and coverage begins immediately. You can add or remove bikes from Dashboard → Courier+.

items.q: What happens if my bike breaks down?
items.a: Contact us via the platform or phone. We'll coordinate pick-up to the nearest certified repair partner — usually within the same day. All labour and parts for covered faults are included. Max plan subscribers can also request a temporary loan bike.

items.q: Which Courier+ plan is right for me?
items.a:
• Basic — standard maintenance and GPS coverage for a single own bike.
• Extra — priority support, extended theft coverage, and faster repair turnaround.
• Max — full coverage for power users, including a temporary loan bike during repairs.

All plans include the GPS device, roadside assistance, and maintenance.

items.q: Can I cover multiple bikes on one plan?
items.a: Yes. When subscribing, enter how many vehicles you want covered and provide their VIN numbers. You can update the VIN list at any time from Dashboard → Courier+.

items.q: What billing cycles are available?
items.a: Monthly, quarterly (every 3 months), bi-annual (every 6 months), or yearly. Longer cycles typically come with a lower effective monthly rate.

items.q: Will I receive an invoice for tax purposes?
items.a: Yes. A VAT invoice is automatically generated after every confirmed payment and available for download in your Dashboard → Courier+ tab.

items.q: How does maintenance work for my own bike?
items.a: When your bike needs service, book it through Dashboard → Courier+ or by calling us. We arrange drop-off at the nearest certified repair partner. Typical turnaround is 24–48 hours. Max plan subscribers can request home collection.

items.q: What if my bike is stolen?
items.a: Report the theft immediately in Dashboard → Courier+ or call our emergency line. You will need a police report reference number. Claims are typically processed within 5–10 working days. Max subscribers receive a temporary loan bike while the claim is in progress.

items.q: How do I track my payments?
items.a: All payment history is visible in your Dashboard → Payments tab. Scheduled upcoming payments show their due date and a Pay button when they become due.

items.q: How does business registration work on E-Renty?
items.a: After creating an account, businesses go through a separate registration wizard where you submit your company details. Your application is reviewed by our team — you'll be on the pending screen until approved. Once approved, you get access to the full business dashboard.

items.q: What is the difference between a business and an individual account?
items.a: Business accounts are not charged the 20,000 Ft security deposit. Beyond that, the rental and Courier+ flows work the same. Businesses also have a dedicated dashboard showing all active rentals, fleet status, and payment history.

items.q: What documents are required for business verification?
items.a: The same KYC documents as individual customers: ID card (front + back), selfie, address document, and business registration certificate.

items.q: How long does business approval take?
items.a: Our team reviews business applications within one business day. You'll receive an email notification when approved or if further information is needed.

items.q: Can we rent multiple bikes under one business account?
items.a: Yes. Each rental can cover multiple units — set the quantity in checkout. All rentals are visible in your business dashboard in one place.

items.q: How does vehicle tracking work for our fleet?
items.a: Each vehicle has a unique fleet ID, battery number, and lock number visible in your dashboard. Vehicle status (idle / rented / in repair) is updated in real time.

items.q: Can we add Courier+ coverage for our entire fleet?
items.a: Yes. Subscribe to a Courier+ plan and enter all the VIN numbers. The Extra and Max plans are designed for multi-bike fleets with priority support.

items.q: What happens when a fleet vehicle needs repair?
items.a: Notify us via the platform or your account manager. We assign the vehicle to a certified repair partner and update its status. For Courier+ businesses, a replacement vehicle is arranged.

items.q: Are invoices issued per rental or per company?
items.a: Each confirmed payment generates its own VAT invoice automatically. All invoices are available for download from your business dashboard and can be filtered by date or rental.

items.q: Can we pay by bank transfer?
items.a: Yes. Select bank transfer at checkout. You'll receive a unique payment reference (ERN-XXXXXX) and our OTP Bank IBAN details. Our team confirms receipt of funds manually.

items.q: What contract terms are available?
items.a: Rental contracts are generated automatically and signed digitally. We offer rental periods from 3 months up to 24 months. For custom enterprise contracts, contact our fleet team directly.

privacyPage.metaDesc: How E-Renty Kft. collects, uses, and protects your personal data in accordance with GDPR and Hungarian law.
privacyPage.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how E-Renty Kft. ("E-Renty", "we", "us") collects, uses, and protects your personal data in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Act CXII of 2011 on the Right of Informational Self-Determination and on Freedom of Information (Hungarian Info Act).

sections.title: 1. Data Controller
card: Registered address: 1012 Budapest, Kuny Domokos utca 13-15, Hungary

sections.title: 2. Data We Collect
paragraphs: We collect the following categories of personal data:
items: Account data: email address, full name, phone number, password (hashed)
Identity verification (KYC): identity card or residence permit scan, selfie photograph, proof of address, and business registration documents
Business data: company name, registration number, tax number (business accounts only)
Rental & subscription data: rental period, selected plan, payment schedule, discount applied, payment amounts and references
Vehicle & bike data: assigned vehicle number, vehicle type, battery and lock serial numbers; Courier+ VIN / frame numbers
GPS and location data (Courier+ only): live location coordinates, movement history, and telematics data for live tracking, theft alerts, and remote-lock
Digital signature data: drawn signature image and signed contract PDF
Usage and analytics data: pages visited, session duration, browser type, device type, IP address — via Google Analytics (GA4), subject to cookie consent
Marketing interaction data: ad engagement via Meta Pixel (Facebook), subject to cookie consent
Server logs: login timestamps, API request logs, IP addresses
afterItems: We do not collect payment card numbers. Card processing is handled end-to-end by Stripe (PCI-DSS certified). We receive only a payment confirmation and a masked card summary.

sections.title: 3. Legal Basis and Purposes
paragraphs: We process your data under the following legal bases (GDPR Art. 6):
items: Performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b)): creating accounts, processing rentals and subscriptions, generating contracts and invoices, identity verification, GPS tracking, and theft insurance claims
Legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)): accounting records retained for 8 years under Hungarian Accounting Act; KYC for anti-money-laundering compliance
Legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)): fraud prevention, platform security, dispute resolution, and service improvement based on aggregated usage patterns
Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)): analytics and marketing cookies activated only when you accept via the consent banner; optional marketing communications

sections.title: 4. GPS and Location Data
paragraphs: If you subscribe to Courier+, a GPS device is fitted to your registered bike. Location data is processed for live Dashboard tracking, theft alerts, remote-lock functionality, and insurance claim verification.
Location data is retained for 90 days of rolling history. It is shared with our GPS/telematics provider (GDPR Art. 28 agreement) and with our insurance partner when a theft claim is submitted.
Location data is not used for advertising, profiling, or any purpose beyond the Courier+ service.

sections.title: 5. Data Retention
paragraphs: We retain your data only as long as necessary:
items: Account & profile data: duration of account + 30 days after deletion request
KYC documents: active contractual relationship, deleted within 90 days of account closure
Rental contracts and signed PDFs: 5 years from end of rental (civil law limitation period)
Invoices & payment records: 8 years (Hungarian Accounting Act)
GPS / location history: 90 days rolling window
Server logs: 90 days
Analytics data: as set by Google Analytics retention settings (default 14 months)

sections.title: 6. Data Sharing
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal data. We share data only with:
items: Payment processor (Stripe): for card, Google Pay, and Apple Pay transactions
Repair partners: vehicle number and repair-relevant information
Insurance partner: name, contact details, bike VIN, GPS data for theft claims
GPS / telematics provider: location coordinates for Courier+ tracking
Accounting software: invoice data for bookkeeping
Google (Analytics & Ads): anonymised usage data, subject to cookie consent
Meta / Facebook: marketing data via Meta Pixel, subject to cookie consent
Authorities: when required by applicable law or court order
afterItems: All processors (other than Meta, which is an independent controller) are bound by GDPR Art. 28 data processing agreements.

sections.title: 7. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
items: Strictly necessary (no consent): authentication tokens, refresh tokens, language preference, consent choice, UI preferences
Analytics (consent required): Google Analytics 4 — anonymised data on pages visited, session duration, device type
Marketing (consent required): Google Ads conversion tracking; Meta Pixel for ad engagement optimisation
afterItems: You can change your consent at any time by clearing the erenty_cookie_consent key from local storage, or by contacting us. We self-host all fonts — no external CDN requests.

sections.title: 8. Your Rights under GDPR
items: Right of access (Art. 15): request a copy of your personal data
Right to rectification (Art. 16): correct inaccurate data via profile settings or by contacting us
Right to erasure (Art. 17): request deletion of your account and data (subject to legal retention)
Right to data portability (Art. 20): receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format
Right to restrict processing (Art. 18): limit how we use your data in certain circumstances
Right to object (Art. 21): object to processing based on legitimate interests
Right to withdraw consent: at any time without affecting the lawfulness of prior processing
afterItems: To exercise any right, email info@e-renty.com or call +36 20 434 0771. We will respond within 30 days.

sections.title: 10. Security
paragraphs: We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures including: encrypted data transmission (HTTPS/TLS 1.2+), password hashing (bcrypt), short-lived JWT access tokens with refresh token rotation, role-based access control, and authenticated access to all uploaded documents and GPS data. KYC documents are never publicly accessible.

sections.title: 11. Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be communicated via email or a prominent notice in the platform at least 14 days before taking effect. The date at the top of this page always reflects the most recent revision.

termsPage.metaDesc: Terms and Conditions (ÁSZF) of E-Renty Kft. for e-bike rental and fleet management services.
termsPage.intro: These Terms and Conditions ("T&C" or "ÁSZF") govern the use of the e-bike rental services and online platform provided by E-Renty Kft. By placing an order, renting a vehicle, or signing a contract, you accept these terms in full. The summary below highlights the key points — the complete, legally binding document is available as a PDF.
termsPage.fullDocDesc: The sections below are a plain-language summary. For the complete and legally binding General Terms and Conditions (GTC / ÁSZF), please refer to the official document.

sections.title: 1. Contractual Parties
paragraphs: The rental agreement is concluded between the Customer (individual or business) and E-Renty Kft. (registered address: 1012 Budapest, Kuny Domokos utca 13-15, Hungary; company registration number: 01-09-437591; tax number: 32690370-2-41).

sections.title: 2. Subscription & Rental Conditions
items: Minimum age: The renter must be at least 18 years of age.
Identity verification: Renters must provide valid government-issued ID or passport, selfie photograph, and proof of address before vehicle handover.
Security Deposit: A security deposit may be required, which will be fully refunded within 5 business days after returning the bike in undamaged condition.
Payment: Subscription fees are billed monthly in advance via Stripe. Late payments may result in remote locking of the vehicle.

sections.title: 3. Vehicle Usage Rules
paragraphs: The renter agrees to use the vehicle with due diligence and comply with all local traffic laws (KRESZ in Hungary).
The renter is prohibited from: sub-leasing the vehicle, modifying the vehicle's hardware, or operating the vehicle under the influence of alcohol or drugs.
Courier+ users must keep the GPS telemetry module active at all times. Tampering with telemetry will trigger a breach of contract fee.

sections.title: 4. Damage, Theft, and Insurance
paragraphs: All E-Renty bikes are insured against theft and third-party liability, subject to a deductible (self-risk) fee of 15% of the replacement value or a fixed amount specified in the individual contract.
In case of theft, the renter must report the incident to E-Renty and the Police immediately (within 2 hours) and provide the police report number.
Normal wear and tear is covered under E-Renty's maintenance plan, but damages due to improper use, vandalism, or neglect are the sole financial responsibility of the renter.

cookiesPage.metaDesc: Information about how E-Renty uses cookies and tracking technologies to improve our fleet management system.
cookiesPage.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how E-Renty Kft. uses cookies and similar tracking technologies on our website and dashboards. You can manage your preferences at any time.

sections.title: 1. What Are Cookies?
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit websites. They help us recognize your browser, remember settings, and optimize your navigation experience.

sections.title: 2. Types of Cookies We Use
items: Necessary Cookies: Essential for basic site features (login sessions, CSRF protection, and lang routing). These cannot be disabled.
Functional & Preference Cookies: Remember your choices (such as your language setting) to personalize your experience.
Performance & Analytics Cookies (Google Analytics 4): Collect anonymous data on how visitors interact with our site, helping us identify bugs and improve loading speeds.
Marketing & Pixel Cookies (Meta Pixel): Used to track the efficacy of our advertising campaigns.

sections.title: 3. How to Manage Cookies
paragraphs: You can change or withdraw your consent using our cookie banner, or configure your browser settings to block or delete cookies entirely. Note that blocking necessary cookies will prevent you from logging into your account.
